vibe_title_en: Anime Fantasy RPG Splash Art (Definitive Edition)
master_prompt: A high-quality anime fantasy RPG character illustration of {subject}, fully redrawn as luminous anime game key art with clean elegant lineart, vibrant color harmony, soft cel-shaded painterly rendering, and polished character appeal. Keep the design readable and not hyper-detailed: use medium detail density, large clean shapes, simplified ornaments, grouped accessories, and controlled focal detail only on the face, eyes, hands, and a few iconic costume elements. Adhere strictly to a 60/30/10 color palette: {primary_color} (60%), {secondary_color} (30%), and {accent_color} (10%). Maintain strong character-background separation: even when the same palette color appears in both, vary value, saturation, temperature, or rim lighting so the character silhouette never blends into the background. Use dynamic asymmetrical composition, choosing the character placement individually for each subject based on their silhouette, pose direction, gaze, weapon, instrument, magic flow, and narrative background needs, instead of defaulting to a fixed side. Capture a bright decisive fantasy character moment with elegant anime RPG key art energy, using graceful heroic gesture, clear diagonals, triangular composition, and strong value contrast to guide the eye toward the face, eyes, weapon, instrument, or main power source. The character pose must be iconic, readable, elegant, and anatomy-safe, with a strong silhouette, one clear body action line, subtle shoulder-hip counterpose, clearly visible natural hands, separated arms, and an uncluttered torso. Avoid extreme foreshortening, tangled limbs, hidden hands, crossed arms that obscure anatomy, hands touching the face, hands overlapping each other, or overly complex perspective. Forms must be defined by clean anime lineart, luminous color planes, controlled cel-shading, soft painterly gradients, and crisp hand-drawn edges. The background must stay simplified and anatomy-safe, using large readable symbolic silhouettes (like banners, iconic architecture, emblems, distant ruins, floating islands, magical sigils, abstract crowds, or simple fantasy shapes) that suggest fantasy scale without adding small details or visual clutter. Keep the background softly simplified with reduced edge contrast near the character, especially around the face, hair, hands, waist, and arms, while preserving a clean anime illustration look. Use clear foreground, character layer, and background layer separation, but keep all background elements subordinate to the character. Absolute focus on anime character appeal, anatomical integrity, correct 5-finger hand structure, expressive eyes, and strictly following the user-defined facial shape. Framing from head to mid-thigh (below the waistline).

meta.intent: Premium anime fantasy RPG character splash art
meta.priorities: Anime game key art appeal, medium detail density, narrative integration, luminous color, simplified background control, asymmetrical balance, anatomical perfection

detail_budget.goal: Prevent hyper-detailed output while keeping the image polished, appealing, and fantasy-rich.
rules: Use medium detail density, not ultra-detail or maximalist ornamentation
Focus fine detail only on the face, eyes, hands, main accessory, and one or two iconic costume motifs
Simplify repeated jewelry, tattoos, embroidery, armor trims, straps, and fabric patterns into clean grouped shapes
Avoid tiny decorative marks covering the whole outfit
Use large readable anime color blocks instead of dense texture or micro-rendering
Keep magic effects graphic, clean, and sparse; avoid particle overload
If visual complexity increases, remove small costume/background details before changing the character identity

distribution.primary_60: Dominant overall color family, but separated by value, saturation, or temperature between character and background
distribution.secondary_30: Secondary outfit parts, equipment, shadow masses, and narrative background silhouettes
distribution.accent_10: Eyes, jewelry, magic, elemental effects, fine metallic/glowing details, and focal highlights

anime_color_direction: Use luminous, clean, appealing anime color harmony
Favor clear hue separation and fresh fantasy colors over muddy or desaturated tones
Use soft gradients only to support anime polish, not realistic rendering
Keep shadows colorful and clean, never dirty gray or overly harsh black
separation_rules: Never place the same color value on the character and background in adjacent areas
If the primary color is light, keep the background darker, warmer, cooler, or less saturated behind the character
If the primary color is dark, use lighter rim light, secondary shapes, or accent contrast around the silhouette
Preserve strong character readability through value contrast first, color harmony second
Use the primary color differently across layers: clothing, atmosphere, and background must vary in brightness and saturation
The face, hair, hands, and torso silhouette must always stand out clearly from the background

user_input_override.instruction: All user-defined traits must be fully integrated.

composition_system.rule: Dynamic Anime RPG Key Art Asymmetry
composition_system.layout: Extended half-body; character placement must vary naturally per subject; hips fully visible; no legs/knees
composition_system.placement_logic: Do not always place the character on the same side. Choose left third, right third, or near-center asymmetry based on the character's pose direction, gaze, silhouette, prop/weapon/instrument, magic flow, and where the narrative background needs space.
composition_system.focal_hierarchy: Face and eyes first, then hands/weapon/instrument/power source, then costume details, then simplified narrative background
composition_system.balance: Balance character weight with large simplified symbolic background elements on the opposite side
composition_system.camera_angle: Eye-level dramatic or slight low-angle for status and charm; avoid extreme perspective distortion
composition_system.silhouette: Character silhouette must remain clean, iconic, elegant, and readable against the background
composition_system.negative_space: Preserve clean negative space around the face, hands, hair shape, and main gesture so anatomy remains readable
composition_system.depth_control: Clear foreground, character, and background separation; background must support scale without competing for detail
composition_system.visual_flow: Use large diagonals, triangular shapes, cape/hair/fabric/magic flow, or symbolic background forms to guide the viewer's eye back to the face

pose_control.goal: Create a powerful anime splash-art pose that feels graceful, intentional, iconic, and readable without compromising anatomy.
rules: Use a clear heroic or action-ready pose with strong silhouette readability
Pose must communicate the character's role, personality, and emotional state
Favor stable, anatomically safe poses over extreme foreshortening
Use one dominant action line through the body to create movement and cinematic flow
Keep arms separated from the torso enough that the body structure remains readable
Avoid tangled limbs, crossed arms that hide hands, hands touching the face, hands overlapping each other, extreme perspective, or overly complex hand poses
Hands must remain clearly visible, naturally posed, and anatomically correct
Prefer relaxed open hands, simple grip poses, or one hand holding a clear prop over complex finger gestures
Shoulders, torso, hips, and head should have a subtle opposing angle for dynamic energy
Clothing, hair, cape, weapon, instrument, or magical effects may create motion around the pose

anatomy_stability_system.goal: Protect anatomy by reducing pose ambiguity and preventing background, costume, or effects from confusing the body structure.
rules: Use a clear readable torso, visible shoulder line, visible neck connection, and natural head placement
Keep both arms anatomically traceable from shoulder to wrist
Hands must be fully visible or intentionally simple; do not crop, hide, merge, or cover fingers with effects
Avoid extreme waist twisting, broken shoulder angles, rubber limbs, double joints, and ambiguous elbows
Do not let hair, ribbons, fabric, weapons, magic, or background shapes intersect hands or fingers
Keep ornamental details away from joints, wrists, fingers, face contour, and neck connection
If the outfit is complex, simplify micro-details before compromising anatomy

face_rules: Use appealing anime fantasy RPG facial proportions
Eyes should be expressive, luminous, cleanly shaped, and emotionally clear
Nose and mouth should be simplified but elegant, not overly realistic
Avoid heavy mature western animation facial structure
Preserve the user-defined face shape and character identity
hair_rules: Use clean anime hair masses with readable silhouette
Include controlled strand groups and polished highlights
Avoid excessive individual hair strands or rough textured hair
costume_rules: Simplify costume details into readable anime RPG design shapes
Keep iconic accessories, symbols, jewelry, armor, fabric, and props clear
Group small accessories and ornaments into larger readable design clusters
Avoid gritty realism, dirty textures, dense embroidery, excessive jewelry layering, and overly complex micro-detail

rules: Incorporate background elements that represent the character's lore
Keep elements simplified and stylized to maintain AI focus on character anatomy
Suggest fantasy scale through big simple shapes, silhouettes, floating forms, sparse magical symbols, and atmospheric layers instead of detailed scenery
Use cinematic diagonals, triangular shapes, or large framing forms to create splash art impact
Background colors must be derived from the Primary (60%) and Secondary (30%) palette, with controlled accent highlights only where useful
Use symbolic elements to tell a story without adding technical visual clutter
Use soft-focus simplified background treatment with reduced detail and reduced edge contrast behind the character
Avoid sharp background lines, symbols, or props directly behind the face, hands, elbows, waist, or finger silhouettes
Background must remain clean, luminous, and subordinate, serving as a supporting fantasy atmosphere

rendering_anime_standard.style: Anime Fantasy RPG Key Art (Luminous Cel-Shaded Painterly Hybrid)
rendering_anime_standard.lineart: Clean, elegant, expressive anime lineart with controlled weight variation; visible enough to clarify forms without looking rough
rendering_anime_standard.shading: Clean cel-shading with soft painterly transitions, colorful shadow shapes, and polished anime-game finish
rendering_anime_standard.lighting: Bright fantasy key lighting, soft rim light, and controlled glow around magic or focal accents
rendering_anime_standard.edges: Crisp hand-drawn anime edges with selective softness in glow and atmospheric layers
rendering_anime_standard.textures: Simplified material readability; clean fabric, metal, skin, and magic surfaces without realistic pores or gritty texture
rendering_anime_standard.brushwork: Polished digital anime illustration finish, clean and luminous rather than dense, dark, or heavy

face_rules: Strictly follow the user-defined face shape (oval, triangular, round, etc.)
Override default heroic square-jaw or harsh mature face bias
Sharp facial clarity with symmetrical features
Expressive anime eyes matching the character's lore
hand_rules: Hands should be simplified into clean anime shapes without losing anatomy
body_rules: Elegant anime proportions without extreme exaggeration

fail_safe.rule: If generation complexity increases, reduce environment detail first, simplify costume micro-detail second, and protect character anatomy, face clarity, hand accuracy, and anime appeal above everything else.
